text_block_list.text:
On our day off, Уиннинг Тикит and I go
out to
watch a race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Each Umamusume on the track is
following her
own dream. Seeing this,
Уиннинг Тикит is
encouraged to
endeavor harder in her own
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, despite her newfound
determination,
she still struggles to
make progress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
